notes.title: Row Divers Changelog V1
notes.content:
🆕  [b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]     Shift to Sprint: Enable and disable running by pressing Shift.
[*]     Numpad Support: Control abilities and switch shooting modes with your numpad.
[/list]

🔧 [b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]     Settings Persistence: Resolved issues with settings not saving correctly.
[*]     Balance Tweaks: Porcupine and Impact Armor effectiveness increased.
[*]     Cost Reductions: Lower costs for Shoot on Hold and Auto Shoot.
[/list]

notes.title: Row Divers Release on May 16th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Row Divers will be launching on May 16th 2025!
Experience a short, experimental incremental game about diving into dungeons in the form of rows, shooting enemies, collecting resources, and upgrading your bow to conquer the depths.

Link to the store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572300/Row_Divers/
